classification: V16 binding BUY rules; vectorized historical replay

performance.drawdown_note: Equal-weight mean returns are compounded by entry date. This is a cohort diagnostic, not a capital-constrained portfolio backtest, because trades can overlap across symbols.

method_notes: Four years of daily OHLCV are requested so EMA200 and 50 completed weekly candles are warm before the two-year measured window.
Signals use only data available on each signal date; entry is the next session open and exit is the close after the configured holding period.
After a BUY, the same ticker cannot enter another trade before the prior trade's exit date, matching V16 production backtest behavior.
Yahoo adjusted OHLCV is the external data source; coverage.csv records missing and insufficient-history symbols.
